cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I've put my wet sock beside your dinner. From your puddle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then you won't mind it sharing the table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An apology would dry the atmosphere considerably.

mechanism: A displays a soaked sock as evidence of B inconvenience and uses exacting damage-assessment distinctions to make an apology the quickest way to clear dinner.
confusable: Simple revenge only causes discomfort; A explicitly offers apology as the route to ending the inconvenient demonstration.
comparison: Missed-bus alternative presents a timeline and actual receipts; sock scene makes damage physically hard to ignore at dinner.
seedUse: Wet sock beside dinner and only-water objection derive from D27-a; S03 treats the item as a damage sample with precise limits on what has been resolved.
